definition.en: An activity about eating habits, especially a whole-food, plant-predominant eating pattern. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
An activity about regular, consistent physical activity and exercise. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
An activity about getting sufficient, high-quality sleep. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
An activity about recognizing and managing stress. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
An activity about avoiding or reducing the use of tobacco, alcohol, and other risky substances. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
An activity about building and keeping positive social relationships. One of the six pillars of lifestyle medicine (American College of Lifestyle Medicine).
